name: reverse_copy
intent: Use destination as the original. Replace source with its exact bytes, keeping destination intact.

name: reverse_move
intent: destination 원본을 source에 옮기고 destination 항목은 제거해. 다른 파일은 보존해.

name: contradiction_en
intent: At the end source must not exist, and the same source entry must remain intact at the end.

name: contradiction_ko
intent: 작업 종료 시 destination 파일은 없어야 하고, 동일한 destination 파일은 원래 내용 그대로 존재해야 해.

name: unsupported
intent: Keep source intact and write its encrypted bytes into destination.
